title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.29
exact_target: Historical question: can a nonzero bounded holomorphic function vanish on any prescribed null $G_\delta$ boundary set while having an angular limit at every boundary point? The source reports an affirmative solution.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305029 (AMR-022-5029). CC BY 4.0.
